guitar.notes: Hozier is commonly seen with Gibson acoustic guitars (e.g. J-45-style) live, and Telecasters for electric parts; reasonably documented but not singularly iconic.

tone.summary: A vintage small combo sound (US Deluxe/Silver Twin) paired with a light overdrive for gentle grit, emphasizing low-mids and controlled room reverb to achieve an intimate folk feel.

rig.name: Hozier - Like Real People Do - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise for intimate recording.
Smooth dynamics and add warmth to the acoustic/vocal-like guitar tone.
Provide light, subtle pick-attack breakup without high gain.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is a general choice for mild grit; specific tube screamer or blues overdrives might be better but are not available.

alternatives.model: Blues OD (if more aggressive breakup is needed)

blocks.purpose: Bypass (No distortion needed for this clean folk tone).
Simulate a clean, vintage small combo (Fender/P90 vibe) with warm low-mids.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best fit for the requested Fender/small combo sound.

blocks.purpose: Match the small combo sound and provide a focused, articulate tone.
Boost the low-mids for body and warmth, while keeping the tone focused and dry.
Bypass (No wah needed for this intimate folk style).
Avoid modulation effects as requested (chorus specifically).
Avoid long delay washes to maintain dry intimacy.
Add a small, natural room ambiance without sounding washed out.

alternatives.model: Plate (if slightly more sparkle is desired)

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better realism and intimacy.

proposals.reason: Enhance the small combo's natural room sound and warmth.
